description: This file defines a SQLite driver implementation for the Notesnook project, including classes for managing database connections, transactions, and creating a dialect for the database interface.

classes.name: SqliteDriver
classes.description: Implements the Driver interface to manage SQLite database connections, transactions, and worker interactions.

classes.name: SqliteWorkerConnection
classes.description: Implements DatabaseConnection to execute queries via a web worker.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the driver by resolving the database path and opening the worker connection.

methods.name: acquireConnection
methods.description: Acquires the database connection, ensuring only one connection at a time using a mutex.

methods.name: streamQuery
methods.description: Throws an error as streaming is not supported.

methods.name: executeQuery
methods.description: Executes a compiled SQL query via the worker.

methods.name: createDialect
methods.description: Creates a database dialect with driver, adapter, introspector, and query compiler.
